lines: Signed out, and the hours logged against your name like anybody else's.
You are in the ledger now. Two hundred years of us and one line of you.
Four Crests before we let anybody under the town. Emberfall's is the fourth.
That is not us being grand. It is six hours of low water and no second try.
Venom Hall. Officially. Everyone here calls it the Pile House and always has.
We read the posts this town stands on. The Hall is how we find out who can.
Name in the book, and take these. Nobody goes under without them.
Not because anything down there will bite you. Because we are not fools.
You received 3 Clearleaves.
Keeper Tallow is down at the great pile and she will not come up for you.
Hatch is behind me. Read the board over it before you go through it.
Eleven bites in two hundred years, and I have the notes on all eleven.
Every single one was somebody putting a hand where a hand had no business being.
People come here expecting a monster under the floor. There is no monster.
There is a tenant, and it is a better tenant than we have ever been.
Six weeks on one reel. You cannot hurry it and you cannot take more than there is.
Two hundred years of not being greedy is the whole trade. I know how that sounds.
A Foundation man came in the spring and offered to double the yield.
He had figures. Good ones. Annik walked him round the ledger to 1849 and he went quiet.
Six hours under, six hours dry. This is the dry bit and I intend to defend it.
There was a lad down there yesterday. Tarin, he said. Loud on the walk, quiet in the water.
Asked me one question the whole way round and it was the right one. Where does the rail stop.
My gran says the town is a guest and I am not allowed to say that outside.
She says the floor is not ours, we just walk on it. Which is what a guest does.
